framework.name: Karmayogi-Grid Official Statistics Competency Framework
framework.description: Prototype competency framework for Karmayogi-Grid. Competency levels and definitions require validation by relevant subject-matter experts.

competencies.name: Sampling
competencies.description: The ability to understand, select, design, justify, and evaluate sampling approaches.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Select an appropriate basic sampling method.
learning_objectives: Select an appropriate basic sampling method for a given situation.
Explain the basic reasoning behind the selected method.
knowledge_indicators: Can identify when a basic sampling method is appropriate.
observable_behaviours: Selects an appropriate basic sampling method.
Explains the basic reason for selecting the method.

levels.name: Proficient
levels.description: Design and justify a sampling strategy.
learning_objectives: Design a sampling strategy for a statistical use case.
knowledge_indicators: Demonstrates understanding of sampling design principles.
Explains the relationship between the sampling objective and selected design.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Evaluate complex sampling designs and recommend improvements.
learning_objectives: Identify limitations or weaknesses in sampling designs.
knowledge_indicators: Demonstrates advanced understanding of sampling design.

evidence_dimensions.name: Knowledge
evidence_dimensions.description: Evidence that the learner understands relevant concepts and terminology.

evidence_dimensions.name: Applied Reasoning
evidence_dimensions.description: Evidence that the learner can apply concepts to a situation and explain the reasoning.

evidence_dimensions.name: Case / Design
evidence_dimensions.description: Evidence that the learner can design and justify an appropriate solution.

evidence_dimensions.name: Practical / Work
evidence_dimensions.description: Evidence that the learner can perform the relevant task in a realistic context.
